title: Request Cost Control Rules
description: Define budget guardrails for gateway requests across subjects, models, and metadata.

empty: No budget limiting rules have been created yet.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Limit the rule scope by request subject, model, or metadata.
filters.helper: With no filters, this rule applies to every gateway request.
filters.empty: No filters added yet; this rule covers all traffic.

form.headerDescription: Configure the credit ceiling, scope, and gateway behavior after the limit is reached.
form.stickyDescription: Review the rule identifier and scope before saving.

descriptions.ruleIdentity: Choose a stable technical identifier for referencing this rule.
descriptions.budget: Set the credit ceiling, calculation period, and budget partitioning.
descriptions.behavior: Choose whether the gateway refuses requests once the limit is spent or only records the crossing.
descriptions.limit: Up to two decimals, for example 250 or 12.5.
descriptions.thresholds: Crossing each percentage of the limit is recorded in gateway logs and metrics. No notification is sent.

block.title: Refuse requests
block.description: Once the limit is spent, further requests fail with budget_exceeded.

alert.title: Record an alert only
alert.description: Requests are never refused; spend is counted and threshold crossings are recorded.
